title: Generalize Icon Union For All Canvases
description: Introduce one canonical structured Icon discriminated union (url, shortcode, data image, emoji, typst, text, plus inline svg / catalog) shared across TS and Rust, with a bidirectional string codec for the WASM wire form, and refactor every canvas, the UI chrome, the icon editor, and the compose domain to resolve icons through it — keeping puzzle 2d behavior identical.
summary: Introduced a canonical structured Icon union (url, shortcode, data, emoji, typst, text, svg, catalog) shared across Rust and TypeScript with bidirectional encode/decode string codecs for the WASM wire form. Extended infinite_cavas icon_codec with build-time shortcode table, text/shortcode/url resolution, broader data mime types (svg/webp/gif), and catalog key resolution via themed_lookup (fixes metabolism keys like capsule_J). Unified ui/react Icon component and IconSelector for all kinds; puzzle 2d re-exports shared classifier and prefetches url icons to data: before WASM sync. Compose sketchpad normalizes domain icon strings through the shared codec. Re-exported icon helpers from infinite/cavas/react-renderer for all canvas bridges. Tests: infinite_cavas 10 passed, puzzle_2d icon tests 3 passed, ui/react iconCodec vitest 2 passed.
